parameter_counting: unique stored/tied parameters; tied LM head is not double counted

element_protected.source_sensitivity: EMA of squared independent English calibration gradients; matrix-wise mean normalized
element_protected.selection: top 15% individual elements in every Attention/MLP matrix by normalized target first-moment strength divided by 1 + normalized English sensitivity
element_protected.frozen: embedding/tied lm_head, norms, biases, and every parameter outside 196 2-D transformer matrices
element_protected.cumulative_unique_update_fraction: not recorded; dynamic masks mean it can exceed the per-step 12.73%

element_unprotected.difference: English sensitivity denominator removed; score is normalized absolute target first moment

edge_projected_rows.basis_estimator: deterministic randomized covariance range finder Q=qr(sum X^T X Omega), seed42
edge_projected_rows.selection: top 50% output rows per candidate matrix by projected-delta row mean square; all columns in selected rows update
edge_projected_rows.frozen: all parameters outside the 70 Attention/MLP matrices in the selected ten layers; within candidates, unselected rows per mask interval
edge_projected_rows.cumulative_unique_update_fraction: not recorded; dynamic row masks mean it can exceed the per-step 15.16%

edge_rows_no_projection.difference: projection alpha is 0; same layers, row budget, mask interval, optimizer and data

optimizer_common.moments: FP32 m/v for every candidate parameter
optimizer_common.inactive_parameter_rule: no parameter update and no weight decay; candidate moments still update

interpretation: sparse nonzero parameter updates, not sparse forward/backward compute or adapter storage; final artifact is a full model
